title: remove cssClasses: {header: '', item: ''} from the docs snippets
body:
I think already having them pretty much everywhere else (all options, html output) makes it not mandatory to have them in the code snippets. People will dig the options if they are curious/interested.

So we need to give them the right level of information at every level/context

comments.body: I agree, you gave a good reason to remove them: people will copy paste the snippets.
